name: What does a 'turnkey' tiny home build mean?
description: A turnkey tiny home build includes all aspects of construction, from design to final finishes, so your home is ready for immediate occupancy.

mainEntity.name: What does a 'turnkey' tiny home build mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: A turnkey tiny home build means that Zen Tiny Homes handles the entire construction process from start to finish. This includes design, foundation work (if applicable), framing, electrical, plumbing, insulation, interior finishes, and exterior siding. When the project is complete, the tiny home is ready for you to move in, requiring no further significant construction or installation from your end. Our goal is to deliver a complete, ready-to-use home, simplifying the experience for the homeowner.
acceptedAnswer.description: A turnkey tiny home build includes all aspects of construction, from design to final finishes, so your home is ready for immediate occupancy.
